text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Early May. At Tokyo Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Making a dashing appearance onto the 
track is the second favorite, Rhein 
Kraft!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Along with Daring Heart, she makes a 
surprise entry from the Oka Sho 
contenders. Just what kind of performance 
will she show us today!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"In her previous race at the Oka Sho, 
Rhein Kraft gave a powerhouse performance 
that practically declared the mile was her 
stage, but—"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup is a race where the 
fastest runners of this generation gather 
to crown the undisputed king of the 
mile—regardless of the Triple Crown or 
Triple Tiara paths."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"In other words... we can say she must 
possess the true ability worthy of being 
called 'the fastest of an era.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who advanced from the Tiara 
route to the NHK Mile Cup and won... has 
yet to exist.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as the commentator said, it is to 
such an extent—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, unless one possesses the speed to 
define an entire era, one cannot be a 
victor...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(It's true that Craft-san's running at the 
Oka Sho was very powerful. But—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...No. But... no. There's no way that 
could be—...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft is in the lead! Rhein Kraft in 
the lead! Daring Heart closes in, but 
Rhein Kraft holds the front! She refuses 
to yield!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeyaaaaaaaahーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (No way... It can't be—!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Rhein Kraft! Rhein Kraft!! The Oka 
Sho runner takes first across the line in 
brilliant fashion!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft has shown us the run of a 
fearsome heroine!! The fastest horse girl 
of our era is Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa, haaaah... Ah, ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I did…… ittttttaaaaarrrrghhh……!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Rhein Kraft! That was a truly 
wonderful run...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume bearing the title of 
'Fastest of Our Era,' what kind of race 
rotation are you planning next...? We 
would love to hear your thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! First I'll take a short break, and 
then I'll train super hard all summer—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Our next major goal is the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The races I yearn for the most are, 
naturally, the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We'll take the Autumn Tiara just like 
this! I swear I'll seize it!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The most important part of spectating a 
race is the review afterward. Though we 
made it back to the Trainer's office with 
that in mind... neither she nor I had much 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just find myself replaying what I saw 
today over and over again... Her running 
form, that sheer power. It made that much 
of an impression—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That was truly overwhelming. 
...Craft-san's running, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, somehow or another... I boot up 
the PC, and with sluggish movements, open 
the usual shared cloud folder."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft has declared her entry into 
the Shuka Sho. That means counter-strategy 
preparations must continue. ..."Rival Data 
Analysis_37".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I make further adjustments to Rhein 
Kraft's data, which had already been 
revised after the Oka Sho. Upward 
revision. —Upward revision.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(My predictions are being shattered. 
They're being surpassed—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...A sensation I've felt many times 
before.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, today's is something truly 
exceptional. ...She has 'come into her 
own.')

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...A monster—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And thus, destiny stirs within the 
womb.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, *pant*...! *pant*, *pant*, 
*pant*..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, honestly. You really outdid 
yourself... Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, next time for sure. The "Oaks" is 
my true stage.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I won't be left behind like this! I won't 
let you weave this era all by yourself—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And yet another monster— lets out her 
first cry to seize the throne of the 
'Queen of the Oaks.'"
